repos_data.description: 🔥 LimeSurvey – A powerful, open-source survey platform. A free alternative to SurveyMonkey, Typeform, Qualtrics, and Google Forms, making it simple to create online surveys and forms with unmatched flexibility.

MCP server with 39 tools for web design analysis — layout extraction, motion detection, quality scoring, accessibility audit, Core Web Vitals, design comparison, and semantic search via Playwright, pgvector, ONNX Runtime, and Ollama.
